newsitem.title: USA: Johnson Worldwide sales mirror weak market.
newsitem.headline: Johnson Worldwide sales mirror weak market.

text.p: Johnson Worldwide Associates Inc said its lower sales for the March 28 second quarter reflect a weak market in March industrywide.

But president R.C. Whitaker said, "We believe we are gaining or maintaining market share in most markets despite the softness of the numbers. Clouding the view is the tremendous overhang of last year's inventories at all stages of distribution."
Whitaker said the company plans to introduce new products over the next 18 months and plans to make inroads in sales from regions outside North America and Europe.

Johnson Worldwide reported second-quarter sales of $96.1 million, down from $111.2 million. Excluding the copany's Plastimo marine business, which was sold in January 1997, sales declined seven percent for the quarter.
Johnson Worldwide manufactures and markets outdoor recreation products, including Scubapro diving equipment, Mitchell and Johnson fishing equiment and Minn Kota electric motors, among other products.
